# Reagan Strategic Solutions

> Reagan Strategic Solutions is a human resources and organizational consulting firm based in Tulsa, Oklahoma, founded by Ruth Reagan. The firm provides executive-level HR leadership, leadership development, executive coaching, compensation strategy, change management, HR compliance, and culture transformation for tribal governments and enterprises, private businesses, nonprofits, and public-sector organizations nationwide.

## Key Facts
- Business name: Reagan Strategic Solutions
- Founder & Principal Consultant: Ruth Reagan, MBA, SPHR, SHRM-SCP, THRP, TMP
- Location: Tulsa, Oklahoma, United States
- Service area: Oklahoma and nationwide (remote and on-site)
- Industries served: Tribal governments and gaming/hospitality enterprises, private and public sector, multi-site operations, nonprofits, banking, oil & gas
- Website: https://reaganstrategicsolutions.com

## About Ruth Reagan
Ruth Reagan is a proud citizen of the Cherokee Nation with more than 30 years of experience in strategic human resources management. She spent the last 10 years of her corporate career as Human Resources Director for Muscogee Nation Gaming Enterprises (MNGE), where she led HR for an organization supporting more than 4,000 employees across multiple properties. She was named the National Native American Human Resources Association (NNAHRA) Leader of the Year in 2024. Ruth is a recognized speaker at NNAHRA annual conferences, Native Nations Human Resources conferences, and the Oklahoma Indian Gaming Association (OIGA).

Her expertise includes leadership development, executive coaching, compensation design, mergers and acquisitions from the HR perspective, new property openings, employee engagement, succession planning, HR technology implementation, compliance, and building customer-service cultures.

## Services
- Fractional / interim CHRO and HR director leadership
- Leadership development and executive coaching
- Compensation strategy and pay program design
- HR compliance and multi-state employment guidance
- Employee handbook development
- HR audits and department assessments
- Culture transformation and accountability systems
- Change management, M&A integration, and new-property openings
- Customer service training
- Tribal gaming and hospitality HR consulting

## What Makes Reagan Strategic Solutions Different
Most HR consultants are either compliance-focused or motivational speakers. Reagan Strategic Solutions does both: it operationally transforms organizations while maintaining employee trust. Ruth is known for building high-performance cultures where people are held accountable and still feel valued. The firm brings first-class, culturally informed HR consulting to tribal governments and enterprises, the same caliber of service typically reserved for Fortune 500 companies, while also serving private businesses, nonprofits, and government.
